overridesDocumentation.eslint-plugin-react: Override eslint-plugin-react's eslint peer range to accept eslint 10. As of 7.37.5 the plugin still declares `eslint: ^3 || ... || ^9.7`, which blocks `npm ci` under eslint 10 even though the plugin runs fine on flat config. TODO: remove this override once eslint-plugin-react publishes a release that lists eslint 10 in its peerDependencies.
overridesDocumentation.@types/react: Pinned to an exact version (not a `^19` range) so npm collapses the type package to a single copy. With a range, transitive consumers (e.g. @types/react-dom) can resolve a different 19.x patch, leaving two physically separate @types/react copies — which makes tsc treat React's `Ref`/element types as unrelated and fails the lib.components build (TS2322). Bump this exact version when intentionally updating React types.
overridesDocumentation.react: react and react-dom are pinned to the same exact version (not a `^19.2.x` range) because npm's deduper can otherwise hoist a different react-dom patch to the root than react (e.g. react 19.2.7 / react-dom 19.2.6), which trips react-dom's `react`/`react-dom` exact-version-match guard and crashes every React test. The `react-zdog` nested override keeps that subtree on react 18, which it requires. Bump react and react-dom together when updating React. A Renovate `customManager` (renovate.json) updates these override pins alongside the React group so a React-bump PR moves the effective resolved version, not just the app ranges (ADS-1111).
overridesDocumentation.uuid: Force the transitive uuid copies up to 11.1.1 via the selector `uuid@<11.1.1` to patch the missing buffer-bounds check in v3()/v5()/v6() (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, CVE-2026-41907); everything below 11.1.1 is vulnerable. Reached transitively via service.notifications' firebase-admin -> @google-cloud/storage -> gaxios chain, which declares uuid ^9.0.1; no workspace package depends on uuid directly, so the major-version jump is safe. Do not downgrade below 11.1.1.
